data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Katherine, derived from the Greek word 'katharos' meaning 'pure, clear'. In Christianity, Saint Catherine of Alexandria is a popular patron saint named for this purity. The name Katlin carries the meaning “Pure, Clear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Katlin usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Katlin total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Katlin, derived from the Greek name Katherine, was particularly popular in Christian Europe during the Middle Ages. The name was given to girls as a symbol of purity and innocence, inspired by Saint Catherine of Alexandria, a prominent early Christian martyr and patron saint of unmarried Virgins and scholars.
